finalText:
Created `validate_email.py` with an `is_valid_email(email)` function.

It uses a regex covering the common cases (local part with `.`, `_`, `%`, `+`, `-`; domain with subdomains; TLD of 2+ letters), plus a length guard (RFC max 254 chars) and a type check. Note: fully RFC 5322-compliant validation is far more complex (quoted strings, IP literals, etc.) — this covers realistic real-world addresses, which is what you want in practice. For stricter validation, consider the `email-validator` package, which also checks DNS/MX records.
